''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Brain Invaders]]," in which the [[second occupation of Geonosis]] starts, to [[21 BBY]]. ''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' specifies that the Empire continued to hold its presence on [[Geonosis]] until the [[sterilization of Geonosis]], which is dated to circa [[9 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.<noinclude>
